questions.question: King Amaziah of Judah did what was right in the eyes of the LORD. What was the problem with how he did it?

answers.text: He did it but not wholeheartedly
He did it only in his last years
He did it only when a prophet was near

questions.question: Why did a man of God tell King Amaziah of Judah not to take the hired Israelite army into battle?

answers.text: The LORD was not with Israel
Israel's troops could not be trusted
